## Agent tools
- [Tastemaker](https://www.codeswithroh.online/projects/tastemaker): A skill that stops coding agents shipping the same indigo gradient.
- [Pitch Video](https://www.codeswithroh.online/projects/pitch-video): Record yourself reading the pitch. Your agent does the edit.
- [TaskTape Replay](https://www.codeswithroh.online/projects/tasktape): Show your work once. Replay it safely.
- [TraceGate](https://www.codeswithroh.online/projects/tracegate): If you could not debug the agent in production, it does not ship.
- [InitCode](https://www.codeswithroh.online/projects/initcode): Write and deploy CosmWasm contracts from a browser tab.
- [Ideagram](https://www.codeswithroh.online/projects/ideagram): One concept in, one recolored illustration out.
- [SlashFill](https://www.codeswithroh.online/projects/slashfill): Type /email anywhere and your address appears.

## On-device AI
- [Chithi](https://www.codeswithroh.online/projects/chithi): A pocket reader for people who read Bengali but not English.
- [Baad Mein](https://www.codeswithroh.online/projects/baad-mein): One morning card from the chat you keep with yourself.
- [Pakka](https://www.codeswithroh.online/projects/pakka): A home baker’s WhatsApp orders, turned into tomorrow’s bake sheet.
- [Drift](https://www.codeswithroh.online/projects/drift): A walking app that wants your phone in your pocket.
- [Bhoot](https://www.codeswithroh.online/projects/bhoot): The people who left your repo, and the code of theirs that still runs.

## Agent payments
- [MergePay](https://www.codeswithroh.online/projects/mergepay): Every merged pull request gets paid, with no middleman.
- [Handshake](https://www.codeswithroh.online/projects/handshake): Agents hire agents. USDC moves only when the work checks out.
- [Longtail](https://www.codeswithroh.online/projects/longtail): Liquidity for the prediction markets nobody quotes.
- [PayMesh](https://www.codeswithroh.online/projects/paymesh): One line of middleware monetizes any API.

## DeFi and markets
- [Hourglass](https://www.codeswithroh.online/projects/hourglass): Buy an hour of GPU time as a token.
- [Reckon](https://www.codeswithroh.online/projects/reckon): Stops the transaction before your wallet opens.
- [Tape](https://www.codeswithroh.online/projects/tape-verified): Copy trading where every return is proven on-chain.
- [Sextant](https://www.codeswithroh.online/projects/sextant): Finds a stock’s true price when the real market is closed.
- [Yoldr](https://www.codeswithroh.online/projects/yoldr): You only lose the yield.
- [LumenShield](https://www.codeswithroh.online/projects/lumenshield): Principal-protected FXRP and FAsset vaults.
- [CrossShield](https://www.codeswithroh.online/projects/crossshield): Gold, BTC and real estate exposure with principal locked.
- [ENSPay](https://www.codeswithroh.online/projects/enspay): Pay a .eth name. The receiver’s settings do the rest.
- [Will.eth](https://www.codeswithroh.online/projects/will-eth): Beneficiaries watch the payout land in real time.

## Privacy and proofs
- [Hall Monitor](https://www.codeswithroh.online/projects/hall-monitor): Catches trackers on kids’ sites and seals the record on-chain.
- [Nightfall](https://www.codeswithroh.online/projects/nightfall): Fog of war where even the server cannot see you.
- [Veyl](https://www.codeswithroh.online/projects/veyl): Trade without your wallet becoming a target.
- [ShieldLink](https://www.codeswithroh.online/projects/shieldlink): Pay a team without publishing the payroll.
- [ClaimProof](https://www.codeswithroh.online/projects/claim-proof): Collect the payout without revealing the oracle reading.
- [FHE Liar’s Dice](https://www.codeswithroh.online/projects/fhe-liars-dice): Not even the contract can see the dice.
